fusions.name: Tail Left Behind
fusions.desc: A whipping slash that deals 9 damage and leaves the target 6% easier to wound for 3 seconds. You move 25% faster for 3 seconds afterwards. Also costs 5% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Strike from Stillness
fusions.desc: You dart up to 6 tiles onto the target and bite, dealing 14 damage and leaving it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Basked and Bolting
fusions.desc: Takes 1.5 seconds of stillness to soak up warmth, then increases your dodge chance by 20% for 12 seconds. You move 30% faster for 5 seconds afterwards.

fusions.name: Sun-Quickened
fusions.desc: By day, your dodge chance rises by 10%.
